name: chanmeng-logo-as-code
description: Chan Meng's chanmeng-logo-as-code plugin for Claude Code.

plugins.name: chanmeng-logo-as-code
plugins.description: A Claude Code skill that turns a hand-drawn, sketched, or scanned logo into clean, reproducible code - fitting smooth cubic Bezier curves to the real outline to generate an editable SVG, color/layout variants, and PNG/ICO/favicon exports.
